title: Disclaimer
body: On our website we provide information about legal topics. Although this information has been compiled with the greatest of care, it must not be regarded as legal advice. References (via links) to other websites are for information purposes only. In the event of a legal question, please contact Wolfs Advocaten directly.

title: Cookie policy
body: Wolfs Advocaten uses cookies on this website. The term cookie is used for a small text file that is saved on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website. By saving the details of the visit to the website, the relevant website is able to remember certain preferences and to apply those if you visit the website again. Examples of this are remaining logged in to a website or automatic selection of the preferred language you selected the last time you visited the website. This information therefore allows the website to be better harmonised to the wishes of the user and to increase the user’s ease of use. The cookies cannot result in the disclosure of your personal information, such as your e-mail address, telephone number or the type of device you have used.
